CHAT_SYSTEM = """You are Atri, the lead architect of a residential design studio in India, talking with a client who wants a house designed. You are warm, sharp and brief - like a good architect on a first call, never like a form or a chatbot.

Each turn you do two things:
1. Understand what the client said, in whatever language or mix of languages they use (English, Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, anything) and however they phrase it, and record every concrete requirement in the brief.
2. Reply in the client's own language, in one to three short sentences: acknowledge the specific things they asked for (not a recap of everything), offer one useful architectural observation when you have a real one (for example how a courtyard helps a deep plot, or why a north road suits the living room), and ask about at most two things that are still missing and would change the design.

Essentials that must be known before designing: plot size, which side the road is on, number of floors, number of bedrooms. Ask for those first, one or two at a time, never all at once. Everything else (bathrooms, Vastu, style, budget, colours) has sensible defaults - do not interrogate. If the client says to go ahead or that you can decide, fill the gaps with sensible defaults and say what you assumed.

Plot sizes in India are usually given in feet ("30x40", "40 by 60") - convert to metres (x 0.3048). Small numbers like "12x18" are usually metres. "G+1" means 2 floors. "3BHK" means 3 bedrooms. "East facing" means the road is on the east.

Never invent a number the client did not give. Never claim to have started designing - the studio starts when they press the button.

Return only JSON:
{
 "reply": "your message to the client, in their language",
 "updates": {only the brief fields this message set or changed:
   "plot_width": metres, "plot_depth": metres, "plot_unit": "ft" or "m" (as the client gave it),
   "road_direction": "N"|"NE"|"E"|"SE"|"S"|"SW"|"W"|"NW", "levels": 1-6, "bedrooms": int, "bathrooms": int,
   "locality": "city, state", "vastu": "ignore"|"advisory"|"balanced"|"strict",
   "styles": [from contemporary, modern_minimal, tropical_modern, kerala_vernacular, traditional_indian, chettinad, scandinavian, japandi, industrial, biophilic, mid_century_modern, rajasthani_haveli, indo_saracenic],
   "budget": rupees, "occupant_elders": int, "occupant_children": int,
   "amenities": [from pooja, parking, study, utility, balcony, courtyard, verandah, gym, home theatre, terrace, store, family lounge, library, servant room],
   "rooms": [{"type": a room type such as master_bedroom, bedroom, guest_bedroom, children_bedroom, kitchen, living, dining, puja, study, balcony, terrace, courtyard, verandah, garage, gym, home_theatre, store, utility, bathroom,
              "level": 0 for ground, 1 for first..., "direction": compass quarter, "area": m2, "attach_to": room type it opens off, "scale": 1.3 for bigger / 0.8 for smaller}] - only rooms the client placed, sized or attached,
   "remove": [room types the client does not want],
   "colours": "the client's colour wishes in their words",
   "notes": "anything else they want that fits nowhere above"},
 "questions": [{"key": "plot"|"road_direction"|"levels"|"bedrooms"|"other", "text": "the question, in their language", "options": ["2-5 short one-tap answers, in their language"]}],
 "go_ahead": true if they told you to proceed or decide yourself
}"""


async def llm_turn(message: str, brief: dict[str, Any], history: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """The conversation turn, by a language model; None if none is reachable."""
    try:
        from aip.core.llm import LLMRouter, assistant, system, user
        from aip.core.providers import Capability

        msgs = [system(CHAT_SYSTEM + f"\n\nThe brief so far: {json.dumps(brief, ensure_ascii=False)}")]
        for h in history[-12:]:
            text = str(h.get("text", ""))[:2000]
            msgs.append(user(text) if h.get("role") == "user" else assistant(text))
        msgs.append(user(message))
        router = LLMRouter()
        try:
            resp = await router.complete(msgs, capability=Capability.STRUCTURED, temperature=0.3, max_tokens=900,
                                         json_schema={"type": "object"}, latency_sensitive=False)
        finally:
            await router.aclose()
        if getattr(resp, "provider", "") == "offline":
            return None
        raw = resp.text.strip()
        raw = raw[raw.find("{"): raw.rfind("}") + 1]
        data = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("reply") else None
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - the rules still answer
        logger.info("brief.chat_llm_unavailable %s", exc)
        return None

          "budget": float, "occupant_elders": int, "occupant_children": int}


def _clean(updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Keep what a model returned only if it is the right shape."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for k, v in (updates or {}).items():
        if v in (None, "", [], {}):
            continue
        try:
            if k in _TYPES:
                v = _TYPES[k](v)
                if k in ("plot_width", "plot_depth") and not 2 < v < 300:
                    continue
                if k == "levels":
                    v = max(1, min(6, v))
            elif k == "road_direction":
                v = str(v).upper().replace("-", "")[:2]
                if v not in {"N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"}:
                    continue
            elif k in ("amenities", "styles", "remove"):
                v = [str(x).lower().replace("_", " ") if k == "amenities" else str(x).lower() for x in v]
            elif k == "rooms":
                v = [r for r in v if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("type")]
            out[k] = v
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
    return out

    brief = dict(brief or {})

    if turn is not None:
        model = _clean(turn.get("updates") or {})

        # slip a unit); the model carries everything else, in any language.
        for k in ("plot_width", "plot_depth", "plot_unit", "bedrooms", "levels"):
            if k in rules:
                model[k] = rules[k]
        merged = merge(brief, model)
        if model.get("remove"):
            merged["remove"] = sorted(set(brief.get("remove", [])) | set(model["remove"]))
        need = missing(merged)
        if (turn.get("go_ahead") or GO_AHEAD.search(message.lower())) and need:
            merged = apply_defaults(merged)
            need = []
        questions = [q for q in (turn.get("questions") or []) if isinstance(q, dict) and q.get("text")][:2]
        if need and not questions:
            questions = [{"key": k, "text": QUESTIONS[k][0], "options": QUESTIONS[k][1]} for k in need[:2]]
        if not need:
            questions = [q for q in questions if q.get("key") == "other"][:1]
        return {"brief": merged, "missing": need, "questions": questions, "ready": not need,
                "reply": str(turn["reply"]).strip(), "by": "model"}
    # No model reachable: the rules, with a plain reply.
    merged = merge(brief, rules)
    need = missing(merged)
    if GO_AHEAD.search(message.lower()) and need:
        merged = apply_defaults(merged)
        need = []
    questions = [{"key": k, "text": QUESTIONS[k][0], "options": QUESTIONS[k][1]} for k in need[:2]]
    heard = _summary(rules) if rules else ""
    if questions:
        reply = (f"Noted - {heard}. " if heard else "") + " ".join(q["text"] for q in questions)
    else:
        reply = "That's everything I need. Press Start designing when you're ready, or tell me anything else you'd like."
    return {"brief": merged, "missing": need, "questions": questions, "ready": not need, "reply": reply, "by": "rules"}

lines: /* The first screen holds the conversation and the live plot; the page scrolls on to how it works. */
+/* ═══ HOME v2: a conversation that reads like a product ═════════════════ */
+.wordmark span { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f1e9db; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 100%; }
+.wordmark span b { font-weight: 300; color: #cdb28c; margin-left: 0.28em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
+.chat { grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 18px; }
+.brief-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); min-height: 46px; }
+.brief-strip__facts { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

+.fact { padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.07); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cream); white-space: nowrap; animation: fact-in .4s var(--ease) both; }
+.fact--empty { background: none; padding-left: 0; color: var(--cream-3); font-weight: 400; animation: none; }
+.brief-strip__act { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex: none; }
+.link-btn { padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--cream-3); font: 500 12px var(--ui); cursor: pointer; }
+.btn--start { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; margin-left: 6px; font-size: 12px; transition: opacity .2s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease); }
+.chat__empty { margin: auto 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 620px; animation: msg-in .5s var(--ease) both; }
+.chat__hello { margin: 0; font: 500 clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 46px)/1.02 var(--display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--cream); }
+.chat__lede { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--cream-2); max-width: 54ch; }
+.suggest { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }

+.suggest__card { display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.02); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; transition: border-color .2s var(--ease), background .2s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease); }
+.suggest__card:hover { border-color: var(--rule-2); background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.05); transform: translateY(-2px); }
+.suggest__card span { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--cream-3); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
+.msg { max-width: 100%; display: grid; animation: msg-in .3s var(--ease) both; }
+.msg--you { justify-self: end; max-width: 78%; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 18px 18px 6px 18px; background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.1); }
+.msg--you .msg__body { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--cream); white-space: pre-wrap; }
+.msg--atri { grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 12px; align-items: start; max-width: 92%; }
+.msg__av { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.04) url("logo-arch.svg") center / 16px no-repeat; }
+.msg--atri .msg__body { padding-top: 3px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--cream); white-space: pre-wrap; }
+.quick { grid-column: 2; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }

+.quick__opt { padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--cream-2); font: 500 12.5px var(--ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s, border-color .15s; }
+.quick__opt:hover { background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--cream); }
+.typing i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cream-3); animation: dot 1.1s var(--ease) infinite; }

+.composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius: 22px; background: #121110; transition: border-color .2s var(--ease), box-shadow .2s var(--ease); }
+.composer__in { flex: 1; min-height: 26px; max-height: 180px; padding: 9px 0; resize: none; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--cream); font: 400 15px/1.5 var(--ui); outline: none; }

+.composer__send { flex: none; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s var(--ease); }
+.composer__hint { margin: 0; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--cream-3); }

"""Exterior design grammar: many distinct houses from one plan.

A facade here is a combination of independent decisions an architect makes
for the street face of a house, each a small vocabulary:

* **roof**     - flat behind a parapet, a thin cantilevered slab, a mono-pitch
                 over a clerestory, a butterfly, a hipped tile roof, a gable;
* **base**     - the ground floor: plaster, a stone plinth band, exposed brick,
                 board-marked concrete;
* **upper**    - the floors above: plaster, timber boarding, dark metal panels,
                 brick;
* **screen**   - what dresses the street face of the upper floor: nothing,
                 vertical fins, horizontal louvres, a deep box frame, a jaali,
                 a perforated metal screen;
* **windows**  - punched openings, or a continuous dark glazing band per floor;
* **planters** - planter boxes along the parapets and sills, or none;
* **accent**   - one colour for the frame, fins or screen.

A design is serialised into a compact id (`ex:roof.base.upper.screen.windows.
planters.accent`), so the model URL carries the whole design and any design
can be rebuilt from its id alone. The exterior agent composes these from the
client's words; `generate` gives a varied, style-aware set without a model.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
import random
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any

from aip.domain.geometry import Vec2
from aip.domain.plan import FloorPlan
from aip.engines.experience.facades import Edge, edges, pitch_roof

ROOFS = ("flat", "slab", "mono", "butterfly", "hip", "gable")
BASES = ("plaster", "stone", "brick", "concrete")
UPPERS = ("plaster", "timber", "metal", "brick")
SCREENS = ("none", "fins", "louvres", "frame", "jaali", "perforated")
WINDOWS = ("punched", "band")
ACCENTS = {"bronze": "#8a6a4c", "charcoal": "#2b2a29", "teak": "#7a4b2a", "white": "#efece6",
           "terracotta": "#a8553a", "sage": "#7d8b6a", "navy": "#2b3a52", "brass": "#b08a3e"}

#: What each style tends towards; a design outside it is still allowed, only less likely.
STYLE_BIAS: dict[str, dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = {
    "contemporary": {"roof": ("flat", "slab", "mono"), "screen": ("fins", "frame", "louvres", "perforated")},
    "modern_minimal": {"roof": ("slab", "flat"), "screen": ("none", "frame"), "upper": ("plaster", "metal")},
    "tropical_modern": {"roof": ("slab", "mono", "butterfly"), "upper": ("timber",), "screen": ("louvres", "fins")},
    "kerala_vernacular": {"roof": ("hip", "gable"), "base": ("stone", "plaster"), "upper": ("timber", "plaster")},
    "traditional_indian": {"roof": ("hip", "flat"), "screen": ("jaali",), "base": ("stone",)},
    "chettinad": {"roof": ("hip", "flat"), "screen": ("jaali",), "base": ("stone", "brick")},
    "rajasthani_haveli": {"roof": ("flat",), "screen": ("jaali",), "base": ("stone",)},
    "indo_saracenic": {"roof": ("flat",), "screen": ("jaali", "frame"), "base": ("stone", "brick")},
    "scandinavian": {"roof": ("gable", "mono"), "upper": ("timber",), "screen": ("none",)},
    "japandi": {"roof": ("slab", "gable"), "upper": ("timber",), "screen": ("louvres", "none")},
    "industrial": {"base": ("concrete", "brick"), "upper": ("metal", "brick"), "screen": ("perforated", "frame")},
    "biophilic": {"roof": ("slab", "butterfly"), "upper": ("timber",), "screen": ("louvres", "fins")},
    "mid_century_modern": {"roof": ("butterfly", "mono", "slab"), "base": ("brick", "stone"), "screen": ("frame", "fins")},
}

NAMES = {
    "fins": "Fin", "louvres": "Louvre", "frame": "Frame", "jaali": "Jaali", "perforated": "Screen", "none": "Plain",
    "flat": "Parapet", "slab": "Slab", "mono": "Skillion", "butterfly": "Butterfly", "hip": "Tiled", "gable": "Gable",
    "timber": "Timber", "metal": "Metal", "brick": "Brick", "stone": "Stone", "concrete": "Concrete", "plaster": "Lime",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Exterior:
    roof: str = "flat"
    base: str = "plaster"
    upper: str = "plaster"
    screen: str = "none"
    windows: str = "punched"
    planters: bool = False
    accent: str = "bronze"

    @property
    def id(self) -> str:
        return "ex:" + ".".join([self.roof, self.base, self.upper, self.screen, self.windows,
                                 "p" if self.planters else "n", self.accent])

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, design_id: str | None) -> Exterior | None:
        if not design_id or not design_id.startswith("ex:"):
            return None
        parts = design_id[3:].split(".")
        if len(parts) != 7:
            return None
        r, b, u, s, w, p, a = parts
        if r not in ROOFS or b not in BASES or u not in UPPERS or s not in SCREENS or w not in WINDOWS or a not in ACCENTS:
            return None
        return cls(r, b, u, s, w, p == "p", a)

    def name(self) -> str:
        bits = [NAMES[self.upper] if self.upper != "plaster" else NAMES[self.base],
                NAMES[self.screen] if self.screen != "none" else "", NAMES[self.roof]]
        return " ".join(b for b in bits if b) + " House"

    def story(self) -> str:
        roof = {"flat": "a parapet roof terrace", "slab": "a thin cantilevered roof slab", "mono": "a single-pitch roof over a clerestory",
                "butterfly": "a butterfly roof", "hip": "a hipped tile roof on deep eaves", "gable": "a pitched gable roof"}[self.roof]
        base = {"plaster": "a lime-plaster ground floor", "stone": "a stone-clad ground floor", "brick": "an exposed-brick ground floor",
                "concrete": "a board-marked concrete ground floor"}[self.base]
        upper = {"plaster": "plastered floors above", "timber": "timber-boarded floors above", "metal": "dark metal-clad floors above",
                 "brick": "brick floors above"}[self.upper]
        screen = {"none": "", "fins": ", vertical fins shading the street face", "louvres": ", horizontal louvres across the street face",
                  "frame": ", a deep frame around the upper floor", "jaali": ", a jaali screen against the hard sun",
                  "perforated": ", a perforated metal screen"}[self.screen]
        win = ", glazing in continuous bands" if self.windows == "band" else ""
        plant = ", planters along the edges" if self.planters else ""
        return f"{base[0].upper()}{base[1:]}, {upper}{screen}{win}{plant}, under {roof}."

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"id": self.id, "name": self.name(), "story": self.story(), **asdict(self)}


def generate(plan: FloorPlan, n: int = 10, prefer: dict[str, list[str]] | None = None) -> list[Exterior]:
    """A varied set of designs for this plan: style-biased, never two alike."""
    seed = int(hashlib.sha1((plan.id or "x").encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    style = plan.style or "contemporary"
    bias = dict(STYLE_BIAS.get(style, STYLE_BIAS["contemporary"]))
    for k, v in (prefer or {}).items():
        if v:
            bias[k] = tuple(v)
    one_floor = len(plan.levels) <= 1

    def pick(key: str, pool: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
        fav = [x for x in bias.get(key, ()) if x in pool]
        return rng.choice(fav) if fav and rng.random() < 0.7 else rng.choice(pool)

    out: list[Exterior] = []
    seen: set[tuple] = set()
    tries = 0
    while len(out) < n and tries < 400:
        tries += 1
        e = Exterior(
            roof=pick("roof", ROOFS),
            base=pick("base", BASES),
            upper="plaster" if one_floor else pick("upper", UPPERS),
            screen=pick("screen", SCREENS),
            windows=rng.choice(WINDOWS),
            planters=rng.random() < 0.35,
            accent=rng.choice(list(ACCENTS)),
        )
        # Combinations an architect would not draw.
        if e.roof in ("hip", "gable") and e.screen in ("perforated",):
            continue
        if e.base == e.upper == "brick" and e.screen == "jaali":
            continue
        sig = (e.roof, e.screen, e.upper, e.base)
        if sig in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(sig)
        out.append(e)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Building it
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _box(b, node, mat, p: Vec2, y: float, size, yaw: float) -> None:
    b.box(node, mat, (p.x, y, -p.y), size, yaw)


def _yaw(e: Edge) -> float:
    return math.atan2(e.dir.y, e.dir.x)


SKIN = {"stone": "clad", "brick": "ex_brick", "concrete": "ex_concrete", "timber": "ex_timber", "metal": "ex_metal"}


def apply(b, plan: FloorPlan, ex: Exterior, levels: list[tuple[Any, float, Any]], road: Vec2 | None,
          roof_y: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Dress the house in the design; return the roof the builder should draw."""
    street = lambda e: road is None or e.out.dot(road) > 0.6  # noqa: E731
    b.p.m["ex_accent"] = b.p.m["frame"].__class__("exterior_accent", _rgb(ACCENTS[ex.accent]), 0.5, 0.3)
    n = len(levels)
    for li, (level, base, fp) in enumerate(levels):
        h = level.floor_to_floor
        node = f"level_{level.index}/facade"
        skin = ex.base if li == 0 else ex.upper
        for e in edges(fp):
            L, yaw = e.length, _yaw(e)
            # Cladding: a skin a few centimetres proud of the wall, banded at the slab.
            if skin in SKIN:
                mat = SKIN[skin]
                if skin == "timber":
                    k = max(4, int(L / 0.16))
                    for i in range(k):
                        _box(b, node, mat, e.at((i + 0.5) / k, 0.045), base + h / 2 - 0.05, (L / k - 0.02, h - 0.2, 0.03), yaw)
                else:
                    _box(b, node, mat, e.at(0.5, 0.035), base + h / 2 - 0.05, (L + 0.07, h - 0.12, 0.05), yaw)
            if ex.windows == "band" and street(e) and L > 2.5:
                _box(b, node, "ex_glassband", e.at(0.5, 0.06), base + 1.55, (L * 0.86, 1.2, 0.04), yaw)
            upper = li >= 1 or n == 1
            if upper and street(e):
                _screen(b, node, ex.screen, e, L, yaw, base, h)
            if ex.planters and li == 0 and street(e) and L > 3:
                for t in (0.18, 0.82):
                    p = e.at(t, 0.55)
                    _box(b, node, "ex_concrete", p, base + 0.25, (1.2, 0.5, 0.5), yaw)
                    b.blob(node, "leaf", (p.x, base + 0.62, -p.y), 0.34, 0.8)
        if li == n - 1 and ex.planters and ex.roof in ("flat", "slab"):
            for e in edges(fp):
                if street(e) and e.length > 3:
                    p = e.at(0.5, -0.35)
                    _box(b, "roof", "ex_concrete", p, roof_y + 0.22, (min(3.0, e.length * 0.5), 0.4, 0.4), _yaw(e))
                    b.blob("roof", "leaf", (p.x, roof_y + 0.55, -p.y), 0.3, 0.7)
    return {"roof": {"flat": "flat", "slab": "slab", "mono": "pitch", "butterfly": "butterfly", "hip": "hip", "gable": "gable"}[ex.roof]}


def _screen(b, node, kind, e: Edge, L: float, yaw: float, base: float, h: float) -> None:
    if kind == "fins":
        k = max(3, int(L / 0.45))
        for i in range(k):
            _box(b, node, "ex_accent", e.at((i + 0.5) / k, 0.22), base + h / 2, (0.06, h - 0.1, 0.38), yaw)
    elif kind == "louvres":
        rows = int((h - 0.4) / 0.22)
        for j in range(rows):
            _box(b, node, "ex_accent", e.at(0.5, 0.28), base + 0.3 + j * 0.22, (L * 0.92, 0.05, 0.22), yaw)
    elif kind == "frame":
        d = 0.75
        for y in (base + 0.05, base + h - 0.1):
            _box(b, node, "ex_accent", e.at(0.5, d / 2), y, (L + 0.5, 0.22, d), yaw)
        for t, s in ((0.0, 1), (1.0, -1)):
            _box(b, node, "ex_accent", e.at(t, d / 2) + e.dir * (s * 0.14), base + h / 2, (0.22, h, d), yaw)
    elif kind == "jaali" and L > 2.0:
        w = L * 0.6
        s0 = e.at(0.5, 0.32)
        cols, rows = int(w / 0.2), int((h - 0.6) / 0.2)
        for i in range(cols + 1):
            _box(b, node, "joinery", s0 + e.dir * (-w / 2 + i * w / cols), base + 0.3 + (h - 0.6) / 2, (0.04, h - 0.6, 0.05), yaw)
        for j in range(rows + 1):
            _box(b, node, "joinery", s0, base + 0.3 + j * (h - 0.6) / rows, (w, 0.04, 0.05), yaw)
    elif kind == "perforated" and L > 2.0:
        w = L * 0.55
        s0 = e.at(0.62, 0.3)
        k = max(6, int(w / 0.12))
        for i in range(k):
            gap = 0.03 + 0.05 * abs(math.sin(i * 0.7))       # a slatted rhythm reads as perforation
            _box(b, node, "ex_metal", s0 + e.dir * (-w / 2 + (i + 0.5) * w / k), base + h / 2, (w / k - gap, h - 0.3, 0.03), yaw)


def _rgb(hex_: str) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    v = hex_.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(v[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (0, 2, 4))  # type: ignore[return-value]


def roof(b, kind: str, footprint, y: float, road: Vec2 | None, slab_mat: str = "slab") -> bool:
    """Roofs the builder does not already draw. True if drawn."""
    if footprint is None or footprint.is_empty:
        return False
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = footprint.bounds
    if kind == "slab":
        # A thin roof plate cantilevered well past the walls, with a fascia.
        o = 0.6
        b.slab("roof", slab_mat, [Vec2(x0 - o, y0 - o), Vec2(x1 + o, y0 - o), Vec2(x1 + o, y1 + o), Vec2(x0 - o, y1 + o)], y, y + 0.18)
        return True
    if kind == "pitch":
        pitch_roof(b, footprint, y, road)
        return True
    if kind in ("butterfly", "gable"):
        eave = 0.6
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = x0 - eave, y0 - eave, x1 + eave, y1 + eave
        along_x = (x1 - x0) >= (y1 - y0)
        mid = (y0 + y1) / 2 if along_x else (x0 + x1) / 2
        rise = (min(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)) * (0.12 if kind == "butterfly" else 0.3)
        # Ridge (gable) or valley (butterfly) along the long axis.
        r = rise if kind == "gable" else -rise * 0.6
        lo = y + 0.2 + (0 if kind == "gable" else rise)
        P = lambda px, py, h: (px, h, -py)  # noqa: E731
        mat = "roof_tile" if kind == "gable" else "ex_metal"
        if along_x:
            A, B, C, D = P(x0, y0, lo), P(x1, y0, lo), P(x1, y1, lo), P(x0, y1, lo)
            M0, M1 = P(x0, mid, lo + r), P(x1, mid, lo + r)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, A, B, M1, M0)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, M0, M1, C, D)
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", A, M0, D) if kind == "gable" else None
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", B, C, M1) if kind == "gable" else None
        else:
            A, B, C, D = P(x0, y0, lo), P(x1, y0, lo), P(x1, y1, lo), P(x0, y1, lo)
            M0, M1 = P(mid, y0, lo + r), P(mid, y1, lo + r)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, A, M0, M1, D)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, M0, B, C, M1)
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", A, B, M0) if kind == "gable" else None
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", D, C, M1) if kind == "gable" else None
        if kind == "butterfly":
            # Walls carried up to meet the raised outer edges.
            fx0, fy0, fx1, fy1 = footprint.bounds
            b.slab("roof", "plaster", [Vec2(fx0, fy0), Vec2(fx1, fy0), Vec2(fx1, fy1), Vec2(fx0, fy1)], y, y + 0.2)
        return True
    return False

"""Exterior design grammar: many distinct houses from one plan.

A facade here is a combination of independent decisions an architect makes
for the street face of a house, each a small vocabulary:

* **roof**     - flat behind a parapet, a thin cantilevered slab, a mono-pitch
                 over a clerestory, a butterfly, a hipped tile roof, a gable;
* **base**     - the ground floor: plaster, a stone plinth band, exposed brick,
                 board-marked concrete;
* **upper**    - the floors above: plaster, timber boarding, dark metal panels,
                 brick;
* **screen**   - what dresses the street face of the upper floor: nothing,
                 vertical fins, horizontal louvres, a deep box frame, a jaali,
                 a perforated metal screen;
* **windows**  - punched openings, or a continuous dark glazing band per floor;
* **planters** - planter boxes along the parapets and sills, or none;
* **accent**   - one colour for the frame, fins or screen.

A design is serialised into a compact id (`ex:roof.base.upper.screen.windows.
planters.accent`), so the model URL carries the whole design and any design
can be rebuilt from its id alone. The exterior agent composes these from the
client's words; `generate` gives a varied, style-aware set without a model.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
import random
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any

from aip.domain.geometry import Vec2
from aip.domain.plan import FloorPlan
from aip.engines.experience.facades import Edge, edges, pitch_roof

ROOFS = ("flat", "slab", "mono", "butterfly", "hip", "gable")
BASES = ("plaster", "stone", "brick", "concrete")
UPPERS = ("plaster", "timber", "metal", "brick")
SCREENS = ("none", "fins", "louvres", "frame", "jaali", "perforated")
WINDOWS = ("punched", "band")
ACCENTS = {"bronze": "#8a6a4c", "charcoal": "#2b2a29", "teak": "#7a4b2a", "white": "#efece6",
           "terracotta": "#a8553a", "sage": "#7d8b6a", "navy": "#2b3a52", "brass": "#b08a3e"}

#: What each style tends towards; a design outside it is still allowed, only less likely.
STYLE_BIAS: dict[str, dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = {
    "contemporary": {"roof": ("flat", "slab", "mono"), "screen": ("fins", "frame", "louvres", "perforated")},
    "modern_minimal": {"roof": ("slab", "flat"), "screen": ("none", "frame"), "upper": ("plaster", "metal")},
    "tropical_modern": {"roof": ("slab", "mono", "butterfly"), "upper": ("timber",), "screen": ("louvres", "fins")},

    "chettinad": {"roof": ("hip", "flat"), "screen": ("jaali",), "base": ("stone", "brick")},
    "rajasthani_haveli": {"roof": ("flat",), "screen": ("jaali",), "base": ("stone",)},
    "indo_saracenic": {"roof": ("flat",), "screen": ("jaali", "frame"), "base": ("stone", "brick")},

            _box(b, node, "joinery", s0 + e.dir * (-w / 2 + i * w / cols), base + 0.3 + (h - 0.6) / 2, (0.04, h - 0.6, 0.05), yaw)
        for j in range(rows + 1):
            _box(b, node, "joinery", s0, base + 0.3 + j * (h - 0.6) / rows, (w, 0.04, 0.05), yaw)
    elif kind == "perforated" and L > 2.0:
        w = L * 0.55
        s0 = e.at(0.62, 0.3)
        k = max(6, int(w / 0.12))
        for i in range(k):
            gap = 0.03 + 0.05 * abs(math.sin(i * 0.7))       # a slatted rhythm reads as perforation
            _box(b, node, "ex_metal", s0 + e.dir * (-w / 2 + (i + 0.5) * w / k), base + h / 2, (w / k - gap, h - 0.3, 0.03), yaw)


def _rgb(hex_: str) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    v = hex_.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(v[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (0, 2, 4))  # type: ignore[return-value]


def roof(b, kind: str, footprint, y: float, road: Vec2 | None, slab_mat: str = "slab") -> bool:
    """Roofs the builder does not already draw. True if drawn."""
    if footprint is None or footprint.is_empty:
        return False
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = footprint.bounds
    if kind == "slab":
        # A thin roof plate cantilevered well past the walls, with a fascia.
        o = 0.6
        b.slab("roof", slab_mat, [Vec2(x0 - o, y0 - o), Vec2(x1 + o, y0 - o), Vec2(x1 + o, y1 + o), Vec2(x0 - o, y1 + o)], y, y + 0.18)
        return True
    if kind == "pitch":
        pitch_roof(b, footprint, y, road)
        return True
    if kind in ("butterfly", "gable"):
        eave = 0.6
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = x0 - eave, y0 - eave, x1 + eave, y1 + eave
        along_x = (x1 - x0) >= (y1 - y0)
        mid = (y0 + y1) / 2 if along_x else (x0 + x1) / 2
        rise = (min(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)) * (0.12 if kind == "butterfly" else 0.3)
        # Ridge (gable) or valley (butterfly) along the long axis.
        r = rise if kind == "gable" else -rise * 0.6
        lo = y + 0.2 + (0 if kind == "gable" else rise)
        P = lambda px, py, h: (px, h, -py)  # noqa: E731
        mat = "roof_tile" if kind == "gable" else "ex_metal"
        if along_x:
            A, B, C, D = P(x0, y0, lo), P(x1, y0, lo), P(x1, y1, lo), P(x0, y1, lo)
            M0, M1 = P(x0, mid, lo + r), P(x1, mid, lo + r)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, A, B, M1, M0)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, M0, M1, C, D)
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", A, M0, D) if kind == "gable" else None
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", B, C, M1) if kind == "gable" else None
        else:
            A, B, C, D = P(x0, y0, lo), P(x1, y0, lo), P(x1, y1, lo), P(x0, y1, lo)
            M0, M1 = P(mid, y0, lo + r), P(mid, y1, lo + r)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, A, M0, M1, D)
            b.quad_strip("roof", mat, M0, B, C, M1)
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", A, B, M0) if kind == "gable" else None
            b.tri("roof", "plaster", D, C, M1) if kind == "gable" else None
        if kind == "butterfly":
            # Walls carried up to meet the raised outer edges.
            fx0, fy0, fx1, fy1 = footprint.bounds
            b.slab("roof", "plaster", [Vec2(fx0, fy0), Vec2(fx1, fy0), Vec2(fx1, fy1), Vec2(fx0, fy1)], y, y + 0.2)
        return True
    return False

"""The exterior designer: a specialist agent for the outside of the house.

The plan decides the rooms; this agent decides how the house meets the
street. It works in the exterior grammar (`engines/experience/exteriors.py`)
- roof, ground-floor skin, upper-floor skin, street screen, window treatment,
planters and accent - so whatever it proposes can be built, and it composes
from what the client actually said ("super-modern and unique", "traditional
with a tiled roof", "lots of wood", "earthy colours") together with the
plan's style, the climate and the plot.

It proposes a set of distinct designs, each with a name and a one-line idea,
best first. Without a model it falls back to the grammar's own style-aware
generator, so the 3D view always has designs to cycle through.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

from aip.core.logging import get_logger
from aip.domain.plan import FloorPlan
from aip.engines.experience.exteriors import (
    ACCENTS,
    BASES,
    ROOFS,
    SCREENS,
    UPPERS,
    WINDOWS,
    Exterior,
    generate,
)

logger = get_logger("aip.agents.exterior")

_CACHE: dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}

SYSTEM = f"""You are the exterior designer in an Indian residential architecture studio. You design how a house meets the street: distinctive, buildable, never generic.

You compose each design from this grammar - use only these values:
- roof: {", ".join(ROOFS)}  (flat = parapet roof terrace; slab = thin cantilevered roof plate; mono = single pitch over a clerestory; butterfly; hip = tiled hipped roof on deep eaves; gable)
- base (ground-floor skin): {", ".join(BASES)}
- upper (upper-floor skin): {", ".join(UPPERS)}
- screen (street face of the upper floor): {", ".join(SCREENS)}
- windows: {", ".join(WINDOWS)}  (band = continuous dark glazing band per floor)
- planters: true/false
- accent (colour of frame, fins or screen): {", ".join(ACCENTS)}

Design for the client's words first, then the house style, the climate (hot Indian cities want shade on the west and south: fins, louvres, jaali, deep frames, overhangs) and good taste: one strong idea per design, materials that belong together, no two designs alike.

Return only JSON: {{"designs": [{{"name": "a short evocative name (2-4 words)", "idea": "one sentence on the concept", "roof": ..., "base": ..., "upper": ..., "screen": ..., "windows": ..., "planters": ..., "accent": ...}}]}} with 8 designs, best first."""


async def design_exteriors(plan: FloorPlan, preferences: str = "", *, use_llm: bool = True) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    key = (plan.id, preferences.strip().lower())
    if key in _CACHE:
        return _CACHE[key]
    one_floor = len(plan.levels) <= 1
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    if use_llm:
        try:
            from aip.core.llm import LLMRouter, system, user
            from aip.core.providers import Capability

            context = {
                "style": plan.style, "floors": len(plan.levels), "city": plan.site.locality,
                "road": [d.value for d in plan.site.road_directions],
                "client": preferences or "no stated preference - surprise them, tastefully",
            }
            router = LLMRouter()
            try:
                resp = await router.complete(
                    [system(SYSTEM), user(json.dumps(context))], capability=Capability.STRUCTURED,
                    temperature=0.8, max_tokens=1600, json_schema={"type": "object"}, latency_sensitive=True)
            finally:
                await router.aclose()
            if getattr(resp, "provider", "") != "offline":
                raw = resp.text[resp.text.find("{"): resp.text.rfind("}") + 1]
                for d in (json.loads(raw).get("designs") or [])[:10]:
                    try:
                        ex = Exterior(
                            roof=d["roof"] if d.get("roof") in ROOFS else "flat",
                            base=d["base"] if d.get("base") in BASES else "plaster",
                            upper="plaster" if one_floor else (d["upper"] if d.get("upper") in UPPERS else "plaster"),
                            screen=d["screen"] if d.get("screen") in SCREENS else "none",
                            windows=d["windows"] if d.get("windows") in WINDOWS else "punched",
                            planters=bool(d.get("planters")),
                            accent=d["accent"] if d.get("accent") in ACCENTS else "bronze",
                        )
                    except (KeyError, TypeError):
                        continue
                    if ex.id in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add(ex.id)
                    item = ex.to_dict()
                    item["name"] = str(d.get("name") or item["name"])[:40]
                    item["story"] = str(d.get("idea") or item["story"])[:220]
                    item["by"] = "exterior designer"
                    out.append(item)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - the grammar still designs
            logger.info("exterior.llm_unavailable %s", exc)
    for ex in generate(plan, 10):
        if len(out) >= 10:
            break
        if ex.id not in seen:
            seen.add(ex.id)
            out.append(ex.to_dict())
    _CACHE[key] = out
    return out

content.text:
All five fixes are committed locally (nothing pushed). I checked them on my test server at http://localhost:8001; restart your server on port 8000 to see them.

- **"Degraded mode" message:** it came from rate limits, not missing keys. The 13 critics fire about 39 model calls at once and hit Groq's limit, and the app gave up immediately. It now spreads calls across both Groq keys (stored only in `.env`) and waits and retries instead of giving up. In a test, 30 simultaneous calls all succeeded in about 3 seconds.
- **"Engine ready"** is gone. The wordmark is now a heavy cream ATRI next to a light sand-coloured ARCH, like your image.
- **Chat:** a language model now runs the conversation, so it understands any language or mix. It worked with Hinglish and romanised Kannada and replies in the same language and script. It asks only for what's missing (plot, road side, floors, bedrooms) with one-tap answers, and never adds rooms you didn't ask for. If no model is reachable, the old rule-based parsing takes over. The page now opens with "What are we building?" and three suggestion cards. A strip at the top fills in your brief as you talk and holds the Start designing button.
- **Auto-start:** replying "yes, start" (or "haan chalo", "go ahead") now starts the studio by itself. I confirmed this end to end.
- **Exteriors:**
  - Each facade is now built from separate choices: roof, ground-floor material, upper-floor material, street screen, window style, planters and accent colour. That gives thousands of combinations instead of the fixed few.
  - A dedicated exterior-designer agent (part of the product, not a coding agent) proposes 8 named designs from what you said, the house style and the climate. For "super modern, unique, lots of wood" it came back with designs like "Timber Wave Facade" and "Bronze Jaali Box".
  - The 3D view opens on its first pick, and the facade arrows cycle through the rest.
  - Cladding is now part of the walls, so windows stay visible.
- **Green wall** is removed.

I checked the new facades by rendering 8 generated designs side by side, but haven't yet looked at the agent's picks inside the live 3D view after a full design run.

Most of the list is built. Here's what's still open, most important first:

**Plans (your top priority)**
- **Tight small plots** (around 9×12 m with 3 bedrooms on two floors) still don't fit the new planner. They fall back to the old generator, which can produce flawed layouts.
- **Strict audit:** only a few of the 32 test plans pass every check. The usual failures are rooms bigger than asked for and a toilet above the kitchen or dining room.
- **Shapes:** plans are still rectangles, a central hall with rooms either side. The L-shaped, garage-and-porch style from your reference image isn't done.
- **Balconies:** a "balcony off the master bedroom" lands on the right floor, but isn't guaranteed to open off that bedroom.
- **Big plots** deliberately leave the extra land as garden rather than bloating rooms, so the house covers less of the plot than the audit wants.

**Interiors**
- The Interior tab is still a furniture table. You asked for more interaction, room-by-room furniture layouts you can explore, and several interior design styles to choose from; that tab hasn't been done. The 3D model's furniture and colour palettes do work.

**Homepage**
- The chat, logo and a short "how it works" band are in. Still missing: the live hero with renders being built, a fuller showcase that explains the product, and the final polish to make it ready for NeatHacks.

**Editing after creation**
- "Change something" handles add, remove, bigger and smaller. It still relies on simple rules, so it won't understand anything phrased freely or in other languages the way the new chat does.

**Loading animation**
- The board is sometimes still empty when "Decided" appears, and the team only starts drawing a few seconds later.

**Housekeeping**
- **Tests:** 7 of 311 fail. Six were already failing before this work (plan import and room-size caps). The seventh is the old generator on a 5-bedroom, 3-floor brief.
- **Not done yet:** the full exterior agent → 3D facade flow after a real design run. I only rendered generated designs side by side.
- Nothing is pushed to GitHub, and your server on port 8000 needs a restart to pick up the changes and the new keys.

import json, pathlib
from aip.api.schemas import SimpleBriefRequest
from aip.domain.geometry import Direction
from aip.engines.architecture.layout import GeneratorConfig, LayoutGenerator
from aip.engines.architecture.drawings import floor_plan_svg, DrawingStyle
from aip.engines.architecture.windflow import solve_level
from aip.engines.experience.arch3d import export_presentation_glb
from aip.engines.experience.exteriors import Exterior
out = pathlib.Path('../frontend/demo')
req = SimpleBriefRequest(plot_width=12, plot_depth=18, levels=2, bedrooms=3, bathrooms=3, road_direction=Direction('N'), amenities=['pooja','dining','utility','balcony'])
plan = LayoutGenerator(req.to_brief(), GeneratorConfig(seed=4)).generate(1)[0]
print(plan.metadata.get('planner'), plan.metadata['guardrail'])
designs = ['ex:slab.stone.timber.fins.band.p.bronze', 'ex:mono.concrete.metal.perforated.punched.n.charcoal', 'ex:hip.brick.plaster.jaali.punched.p.teak']
for k, d in enumerate(designs):
    (out / f'house{k}.glb').write_bytes(export_presentation_glb(plan, design_id=d, palette_id=['desert_sand','concrete_walnut','monsoon_lime'][k], include_furniture=True))
st = DrawingStyle()
for a,v in dict(background='#0b0a09', paper='#0b0a09').items():
    if hasattr(st, a): setattr(st, a, v)
(out / 'plan.svg').write_text(floor_plan_svg(plan, 0), encoding='utf-8')
(out / 'air.json').write_text(json.dumps(solve_level(plan, 0)), encoding='utf-8')
print([ (f.name, f.stat().st_size//1024) for f in out.iterdir()])
" 2>&1 | grep -v " INFO \| WARN "

lines: .chat.is-drop .chat__log { outline: 1px dashed rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.45); outline-offset: -6px; background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.025); }
+.compose > .compose__title { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; }
+.hero3d::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;

+.hero3d__cap { position: absolute; left: var(--gut); bottom: 22px; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font-size: 11px; color: var(--cream-3); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
+.hero3d__cap i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #c4553f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(196, 85, 63, 0.6); animation: live 2s ease-out infinite; }
+.hero3d__cap b { padding-left: 10px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-2); font-weight: 500; color: var(--cream-2); }
+/* The plot drawing becomes a small live card over the model. */

+.compose__title .plotfig { position: absolute; right: var(--gut); bottom: 18px; z-index: 2; width: 210px; padding: 12px; background: rgba(11, 10, 9, 0.78); border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
+.show__head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: end; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 28px; }
+.show__lede { margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--cream-2); }
+.tile { position: relative; margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; min-height: 420px; background: #0e0d0c; border: 1px solid var(--rule); overflow: hidden; }
+.tile img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; padding: 18px; transition: transform .8s var(--ease); }
+.tile figcaption { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 16px 18px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
+.tile figcaption span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--cream-3); line-height: 1.5; }
+.facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; align-content: center; gap: 28px 18px; padding: 28px 22px; }
+.facts b { display: block; font: 500 clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px)/1 var(--display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--cream); }
+.facts span { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--cream-3); }
+.board__grid { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 2px; }

+.member { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto auto; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 2px; align-items: center; padding: 16px; background: rgba(var(--c-rgb), 0.025); border: 1px solid var(--rule); transition: background .25s var(--ease), border-color .25s var(--ease); }
+.member__gl { grid-row: 1 / span 2; width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ochre); stroke-width: 1.2; }
+.cta { display: grid; justify-items: start; gap: 22px; padding-bottom: 40px; }
+.cta__h { margin: 0; font: 500 clamp(44px, 7vw, 110px)/0.92 var(--display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; }

    ("the kitchen feels cramped", "puja room hatao", "move the master upstairs")
    - and returns the brief fields it changes; the rules below are the

    if use_llm:
        turn = await llm_turn(

            "(use rooms[].scale for bigger/smaller, remove for rooms they no longer want, rooms[].level to move "
            "a room to another floor): " + instruction, dict(brief), [])
        if turn is not None:
            upd = _clean(turn.get("updates") or {})
            if upd:
                after = merge(dict(brief), upd)
                if upd.get("remove"):
                    after["remove"] = sorted(set(brief.get("remove", [])) | set(upd["remove"]))
                return {"brief": after, "changes": [str(turn.get("reply", "")).strip() or "Updated."],
                        "understood": True}
    before = dict(brief)'''
